purpose: Standalone build, packaging, CLI, and compatibility adaptations required around the pinned LibreCAD source snapshot.
disallowed: Unreviewed changes inside imported src/ files

entries.reason: Install the three narrow transitive headers required by the imported public façades; hide HandleAllocator and the DataStorage operation enum in a follow-up.
Restore the historical dint*/duint*/ddouble* public typedef names removed by the target C++17 conversion and expose the shared operation-diagnostic schema.
Default the newly added addDimArc callback so existing concrete consumers remain instantiable.
Provide a deprecated composition-based dwgR read façade instead of an unsafe alias to dwgRW, and expose the diagnostic snapshot on both façade spellings.
Define the out-of-line dwgR forwarding façade, preserve null DWG argument/error compatibility, and instrument stage-aware operation diagnostics.
Remove two unused target locals exposed by standalone -Werror compilation; parser control flow is unchanged.
Remove an unused readSchemaNames parameter exposed by standalone -Werror compilation; parsing behavior is unchanged.
Mark one intentionally unused helper and remove two unused locals exposed by standalone -Werror compilation; entity parsing behavior is unchanged.
Remove unused validation helper/captures and mark one unused helper exposed by standalone -Werror compilation; object parsing behavior is unchanged.
Use the canonical DXF group-code table, preserve integer values in codes 260-269, and fail closed on the unassigned 482-998 span.

Route raw DXF capture through the canonical group-code table, preserve null/error compatibility, instrument stage-aware operation diagnostics, and ignore inactive HATCH gradient carriers while retaining active-gradient validation.
Expose the structured operation-diagnostic snapshot while preserving the legacy dxfRW error and version API.
Make the documented setCustomDebugPrinter(nullptr) reset restore an owned default printer so later debug-level transitions cannot dereference null.
